summary: The reader is a computer science undergraduate: they have taken discrete mathematics, an algorithms course (asymptotics, divide and conquer, schoolbook and Karatsuba multiplication, sorting), a first linear algebra course (vector spaces, subspaces, dimension, rank, matrices as linear maps, inverses, triangular matrices, orthogonality, bilinear forms at a basic level), calculus, elementary number theory (primes, gcd, modular arithmetic) and basic machine-level binary representation (XOR, two's complement). They have seen Turing machines with tapes only at an introductory level. They have not been taught the discrete Fourier transform or FFT as such, abstract algebra beyond basic definitions (quotient rings, finite fields as a theory), tensor products, numerical error analysis, or the specific literature on fast integer multiplication.

known.name: Schoolbook and Karatsuba multiplication
known.gloss: The quadratic digit-by-digit multiplication algorithm and Karatsuba's divide-and-conquer improvement to O(n^{log_2 3}) by three half-size products.

known.name: Divide-and-conquer recurrences
known.gloss: Bounding the cost of a recursive algorithm by solving a recurrence such as T(n) = a T(n/b) + f(n).

known.name: Binary and radix representation
known.gloss: Writing a nonnegative integer as a sequence of digits in base 2 or base 2^b, with carries when digit values overflow.

known.name: Two's complement integers
known.gloss: The standard fixed-width encoding of signed integers in binary, with addition performed bitwise with carries.

known.name: Bitwise XOR and arithmetic mod 2
known.gloss: Addition of bits modulo 2, which is exclusive-or, with x + x = 0, so XORing a value twice restores it.

known.name: Logarithms and floors/ceilings
known.gloss: Base-2 logarithms and the floor and ceiling functions, including the rules for manipulating logarithms in growth rates.

known.name: Modular arithmetic and primes
known.gloss: Arithmetic on remainders modulo n, greatest common divisors, coprimality, prime numbers and inverses of residues coprime to the modulus.

known.name: Roots of unity
known.gloss: The n complex solutions of z^n = 1, namely e^{2 pi i k/n}, which lie on the unit circle and form a cyclic group under multiplication.

known.name: Vector spaces, subspaces, dimension and rank
known.gloss: The core linear algebra notions of vector space, subspace, basis, dimension and the rank of a matrix or linear map.

known.name: Matrices and linear operators
known.gloss: Matrices as linear maps on finite-dimensional spaces, with products, inverses, diagonal, triangular and permutation matrices and the notion of two operators commuting.

known.name: Gaussian elimination and triangular factorization
known.gloss: Reducing a matrix by row operations to triangular form, which yields factorizations into triangular factors and solves linear systems.

known.name: Orthogonality and inner products
known.gloss: The dot product on real or complex coordinate spaces, orthogonal and orthonormal bases, and the orthogonal complement of a subspace.

known.name: Norms and the triangle inequality
known.gloss: A size function on vectors, such as the maximum absolute coordinate, satisfying the triangle inequality and scaling, used to bound errors.

known.name: Permutations and bijections
known.gloss: Bijective rearrangements of a finite set of indices, with composition and inverses.

known.name: Cartesian products and multi-index arrays
known.gloss: Arrays indexed by tuples from a product of finite sets, stored linearly in lexicographic (row-major) order.

known.name: Directed acyclic graphs and networks of gates
known.gloss: Directed graphs without cycles, and circuits made of gates connected by wires that compute a function of their inputs.

known.name: Summation, geometric series and induction
known.gloss: Sigma notation, closed forms for geometric series, and proofs by induction on integers.

known.name: Rounding to the nearest integer and exactness
known.gloss: Replacing a real number by the nearest integer or grid point, and the fact that an approximation within 1/2 of an integer identifies that integer.

known.name: Multitape Turing machine running time
aliases: time complexity of a Turing machine
known.gloss: Counting steps of a multitape machine whose heads move one cell per step, so that one sequential pass over n cells costs O(n).

known.name: Integer exponentials and tuple notation
known.gloss: Powers of two and fixed rational exponents of a size parameter, as used in expressions like n^{c} and 2^{-p}.
